producer_report.summary: Fixed at the planning stage: planner.md and the planner brief's Report section now require each demonstration to name its entry point, guards, seam/fake/fixture and injection, and whether the seam exists or which step adds it, and forbid logic under test in the double. critic.md raises a major finding when no seam is named, an absent seam is named, or only a double is tested. The planner prompt was reworded to stay under the 500-token frame guard, so lib.rs is untouched. system-facts lines updated to planner 806 and critic 783 of 1300 (budgets unchanged). Added a unit test and a CHANGELOG entry naming the root cause.

checks_run.note: First run failed (planner 806, critic 783 computed); after updating facts lines, 4 of 4 passed
Returned without an error exit code; output too large to inspect per-test lines, and Grep on the saved output was blocked by policy hook.

criteria_check.criterion: planner.md requires each demonstration to name the production entry point it calls, its guards and preconditions, the seam/fake/fixture and how it is injected, and whether the seam exists today (checked by reading the code) or which plan step adds it; it forbids putting the logic under test inside the test double.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the edited planner.md demonstrations bullet; the new unit test asserts 'seam, fake or fixture' and 'Never put the logic under test inside the double' in PLANNER_FRAME.

criteria_check.criterion: critic.md tells the critic to raise a major finding when a demonstration names no seam, names one the code does not provide, or tests only a double.
criteria_check.evidence: critic.md has the bullet; the unit test asserts 'major finding when a demonstration names no seam'.

criteria_check.criterion: The planner brief rendered by planner_brief in briefs.rs repeats the seam requirement in its Report section.
criteria_check.evidence: Report string extended in planner_brief; the unit test splits the rendered brief at '## Report' and asserts the seam text.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/system-facts.md budget planner and budget critic lines state the computed sizes of the changed prompts, budgets (of 1300) are unchanged, and CHANGELOG.md names the root cause and that it is fixed in the planning stage, not at one job.
criteria_check.evidence: Lines now 806 and 783 of 1300, taken from the budgets test's computed values; CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added entry states root cause and planning-stage fix.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-context asserts the planner brief and the planner and critic prompts contain the seam requirement; `cargo test -p athena-context` passes, and the test fails on the base commit.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test --locked -p athena-context: 71 passed incl. the new test. On base none of the three texts contain 'seam', so it would fail.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` passes, including system_facts_budgets_match_computed and system_facts_drift_is_rejected.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets: 4 passed, 0 failed.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --locked` and `cargo test --locked` all pass, and the producer's report cites each command it ran with its result.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks; I ran cargo fmt --all --check (pass), cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings (pass), cargo test --locked (no error exit); each cited in checks_run.

open_issues: Full cargo test --locked output was not inspected line by line (output too large, saved outside the working directory, Grep blocked).
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG edit failed because the anchor '### Added' was ambiguous; fixed with a unique anchor.
learnings: The planner frame guard in lib.rs requires estimate_tokens(frame) < 500, i.e. under 1500 bytes; the base planner.md was 1386 bytes.
Sizes in docs/system-facts.md are the computed values the budgets test reports in its failure message.
desires: Ability to read saved tool-output files to confirm the full suite's per-test result.
